title: The events route's answer with the generation and each alarm event's outcome
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.2 `urgent_delivered`, 11 H1a, #773), not implemented. The 200 answer of POST /api/station/events with two keys the hub does not send yet: `gen`, the hub's fencing generation, and `outcomes`, what each alarm-carrying event became on the hub. An outcome is given only after the event is durably written. The app sends capture `urgent_delivered` only for `raised`, `joined`, `duplicate` or `suppressed`; for `seen`, `stale`, a word it does not know, or no outcome at all (an older hub), it sends nothing and capture sends the alarm as usual. Both keys are optional: today's answer is valid here.

gen.description: The hub's fencing generation, as in the urgent route's answer: an integer up to 2^53 - 1 or a string of decimal digits, compared by value. `urgent_delivered` carries it.

outcomes.description: One entry per alarm-carrying event of the post (an `alarm` event, or a `traffic` event with an emergency flag or an `alarm_key`).

items.title: One alarm event's outcome
items.description: What the hub did with one alarm-carrying event.

outcome.description: `raised`: it raised an alarm. `joined`: it joined or attached to one (the same radio, still set, a call from before the All clear). `duplicate`: the key's alarm was raised already. `suppressed`: received and recorded, but the admin's settings say no alarm for it (notices off on that channel): final, resending would only loop. `stale`: too old, a late notice and no alarm. `seen`: nothing raised for a reason that can change (its age gate, a clock, no emergency). The first four are delivery; a word the app does not know is not.
